initiative.description: What each combatant rolls for initiative, against its actor’s data. Free-form combatants roll without data.
initiative.title: Formula

order.description: Turn order: highest first (`desc`, the default), lowest first (`asc`), or `sideBased`: the side with the best roll acts first, then the other, each highest first. A side is the actor type’s `controlledBy`; free-form combatants are on the GM’s side. An `orderCombatants` hook replaces the rule.
